ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of fraud schemes in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future fraud case and the Housing Stabilization Fraud scheme. It would examine the methods used by perpetrators and the impact on victims.
questions: What are the most common types of fraud schemes in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a widespread problem and bring attention to the need for stronger anti-fraud measures in Minnesota. By following the money and examining the methods used by perpetrators, we can gain a deeper understanding of the scope of the problem and identify potential solutions.
